name: Cranberry Juice
siboNotes: Pure cranberry juice is well-tolerated for most SIBO patients. Avoid sweetened varieties that may contain high-fructose corn syrup or excess fructose.
preparationTips: Choose 100% pure cranberry juice without added sugars
Start with smaller portions (1/2 cup) to assess tolerance
Dilute with water if the tartness is too strong
Check labels carefully - avoid varieties with apple juice or high-fructose corn syrup
pairsWellWith: sparkling water for a refreshing spritzer
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and antioxidants
Contains proanthocyanidins that support urinary tract health
